description: This file defines a React functional component named ProgressPanel that displays and manages the progress of skills associated with a specific role. It fetches role details and progress data from APIs, allows users to update skill statuses, and handles related state management and rendering.

methods.name: ProgressPanel()
methods.description: Main React component that handles displaying and updating role skill progress.

methods.name: resolveRoleName
methods.description: Fetches and resolves the role name from a role ID by listing roles.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads role details and progress data, and updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Handles updating the status of a specific skill, performing optimistic UI updates and backend API calls.
